# Godot

Build Discord Activities with the **Godot** game engine. This template provides the integration layer between Godot HTML5 exports and Discord's Embedded App SDK.

<Cards>
  <Card href="https://godotengine.org/" title="Godot" description="Open-source game engine." />
  <Card href="/docs/discord-activities" title="Documentation" description="Getting started with Robo.js" />
</Cards>

## Getting Started

Create a project with this template:

```package-install
npx create-robo <project-name> --template discord-activities/godot
```

Then navigate into your project directory:

```bash
cd <project-name>
```

Run development mode:

```bash
npm run dev
```

## Godot Setup

1. Create your Godot project separately
2. Configure it for HTML5 export
3. Build and copy the output to `/public/godot`
4. The Robo.js wrapper handles Discord SDK integration

<Files>
  <Folder name="public" defaultOpen disabled>
    <Folder name="godot" note="Godot HTML5 export" disabled />
  </Folder>
  <Folder name="src" defaultOpen disabled>
    <Folder name="app" note="Bridge code" disabled />
  </Folder>
  <File name=".env" />
</Files>

## Discord SDK Integration

The template includes JavaScript bridge code that communicates between Godot and Discord.

## Hosting

```bash
npm run deploy
```
